    When the conduct check runs on the partner

  Scenario: AC8 The same partner and check date arrive again (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the same partner and check date have been checked once
    When the same partner and check date arrive again
    Then the entry already written is answered and nothing is written, suspended or escalated again

  Scenario: AC9 The partner already reads SUSPENDED, or an instruction already reads RECALLED (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the partner already reads SUSPENDED or an instruction already reads RECALLED
    When the upheld conduct breach is checked
    Then the open set is taken as it stands, the entry names the set it moved and no instruction is moved twice
